opportunities.description: DIGITAL ACCESSIBILITY AUDIT SERVICE INFORMAL REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL PROJECT 26-44 FOR THE COUNTY OF STEARNS, MINNESOTA DUE DATE: 11:00 AM, THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 19 TH , 2026 PROJECT INFORMATION: The County of Stearns is seeking proposals from qualified vendors to provide comprehensive digital accessibility audit services for County‑owned websites and apps for compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Title II requirements and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA. DOCUMENTS: To obtain documents online, please visit Bids & Tenders . You can preview the bid documents with a Preview Watermark prior to registering for the opportunity. Documents are not provided in any other manner. For step-by-step instructions on how to create an Account please refer to the Vendor Support Portal . If you encounter technical issues, please contact support@bidsandtenders.ca or 1-800-594-4798. PROPOSAL SUBMITTAL: ELECTRONIC BID SUBMISSIONS ONLY, shall be received by the Bidding System online through Bids & Tenders not later than 11:00 AM, Thursday, November 19 th ,2026 Hardcopy submissions are not permitted. AWARD: Proposals submitted in response to this RFP shall be valid until January 31 st ,2027 The County of Stearns reserves the right to reject any or all proposals, to waive informalities, to award the contract in whole or in part, and to award to the vendor the County determines is in the County’s best interest. NOTIFICATION: This Request for Proposal is issued by Jennifer Butkowski, Procurement & Contract Specialist.
